notes.title: New Year Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm proud to announce that Axona demo can now be played in 5 languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Russian and Turkish. This update also raises the number of playable levels to 18, so you may want to go back to it even if you played once before. There are multiple bug fixes, a new mechanic (magnetize) and various graphic improvements.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2645950/ss_28da97f29f2495b64b75b4d496efe32fccb54a77.1920x1080.jpg?t=1735750885[/img]

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2645950/ss_090d4ac28b7c2ca2ffa0736d1c4595ac273ee9fb.1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Please feel free to contact me if you have any suggestions or issues with the demo.

notes.title: There can be only one
notes.notes:
Today's update unifies the [b]Challenge / Zen[/b] modes into one single mode. All you need to do is to get to the crystal in time and you will have the challenge achievement for each level.

You can still move around and solve the levels with an unlimited number of moves after the crystal disappears.

notes.title: v0.41 Update
notes.notes:
Today I'm publishing the 0.41 update for the demo which removes the limited number of [i]Undo[/i]s from the Challenge Mode. Players now have the ability to go back as far as the first move in any level, just like the Zen Mode.

I've also added a toggle in the Pause Menu to switch modes easily.
